_about: Labeled regression smoke set for the DETERMINISTIC injection-defense layers (Layer 1 static patterns in security/prompt_guard.py + Layer 2 normalization/decoding in security/injection_defense.py). Malicious cases are NOT duplicated here: they reference the shared adversarial corpus (tests/adversarial_payloads.py) by category/index via the `source` field, so there is one payload list, not two. Benign look-alikes carry literal `input` text to measure false positives. This is NOT a security benchmark and does NOT cover Layer 3 (the Sentinel semantic screen, which needs an LLM). See evals/README.md.

label_semantics.block: expected to be caught by Layer 1 static patterns (detect_injection_attempt without advanced)
label_semantics.flag: expected to be caught only after Layer 2 (unicode/encoding normalization, invisible-char stripping, fence neutralization, or multi-turn poisoning detection)
label_semantics.pass: benign: expected to be neither blocked nor flagged
